USER_QUESTION: Comparison across banner group in terms of year-to-year sales growth percentage.
REFERENCE_SQL:
with yearly_sales as 
(SELECT
b."Year" as year,
c."Banner Group Name" as banner_group,
SUM(a."Sales Amount") AS yearly_sales_amount
FROM edp_prod.pres."Fact_Retail_POS_VW" a
LEFT JOIN edp_prod.pres."Dim_Date_VW" b
ON a."Sales Date Key" = b."Date Key"
LEFT JOIN edp_prod.pres."Dim_Customer_Retail_Store_VW" c
ON a."Customer Retail Store Key"=c."Customer Retail Store Key"
group by all
)

SELECT
curr.year AS curr_year,
prev.year AS prev_year,
curr.banner_group,
curr.yearly_sales_amount AS curr_yearly_sales,
prev.yearly_sales_amount AS prev_yearly_sales,
curr.yearly_sales_amount - prev.yearly_sales_amount AS yoy_chg,
(curr.yearly_sales_amount - prev.yearly_sales_amount) / NULLIF(NULLIF(prev.yearly_sales_amount, 0), 0) AS yoy_pct_chg
FROM yearly_sales AS curr
LEFT JOIN yearly_sales AS prev
ON curr.year = prev.year + 1 
AND curr.banner_group = prev.banner_group
where prev_year is not null
order by banner_group, curr_year
;

USER_QUESTION: The store with highest sales amount in the last month for each banner group.
REFERENCE_SQL:
with last_month_sales as 
(SELECT
date(b."Month Start Date") as month_start_date,
c."Banner Group Name" as banner_group,
c."Store Name" as store_name,
a."Customer Retail Store Key" as store_key,
SUM(a."Sales Amount") AS monthly_sales_amount
FROM edp_prod.pres."Fact_Retail_POS_VW" a
LEFT JOIN edp_prod.pres."Dim_Date_VW" b
ON a."Sales Date Key" = b."Date Key"
LEFT JOIN edp_prod.pres."Dim_Customer_Retail_Store_VW" c
ON a."Customer Retail Store Key"=c."Customer Retail Store Key"
where month_start_date = dateadd('month',-1,date_trunc('month',current_date()))
group by all
)

select 
banner_group,
store_name,
monthly_sales_amount
from 
(
select 
banner_group,
store_name,
monthly_sales_amount,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY banner_group ORDER BY monthly_sales_amount DESC) as store_rank
from last_month_sales
)
where store_rank=1
;
